# Analyzing computer interaction in game code (2026-01-22 20:12Z)

_**User (2026-01-22 21:18Z)**_

In room 9 theres a computer (sprite 1 in the room with extra 103). When looking at this computer Alfred says "Vamos a ver" and that description has an action trigger (F8 0E 01). You can find the description (FF 22 08 0D 01 00 56 61 6D 6F 73 20 61 20 76 65 72 F8 0E 01) at 0x001ED59F in alfred.1

after saying this line an image of the computer is displayed. This image is RLE compressed at 0x1A9EE in Alfred.7

The player can then operate the computer, which is used to browse an index of books in the library (room 9). He is presetned with three choices:

1. Search by title
2. Search by author
3. quit

then he can navigate through the different books using different keys. When seeing a book, the user can "memorize" and then retrieve it from a different part of the game (the shelves in the library). Without this "memorization" you cannot retrieve the books.

I want you to use ghidra to find where in the dissassembled code this computer is handled, and i want you to give me detailed information on how it works. Ideally we get a functional implementation of the behavior of this computer on our scummvm implementation of the game.

Do not use heredoc python. Ghidra is the only source of truth. Rename functions and vars as you go.



---

_**Agent (model copilot/claude-opus-4.5)**_

  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_computer_data.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/find_computer_data.py)",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find computer/book data in game resources.\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef find_resources():\n    with open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n        # Read room directory - 56 rooms x 13 pairs x 8 bytes\n        rooms = []\n        for room_idx in range(56):\n            pairs = []\n            for pair_idx in range(13):\n                offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n                size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', f.read(4))[0]\n                pairs.append((offset, size))\n            rooms.append(pairs)\n        \n        # Find which resource contains the computer data offsets\n        targets = [0x80F39, 0x812F5]\n        \n        for target in targets:\n            found = False\n            for room_idx, pairs in enumerate(rooms):\n                for pair_idx, (offset, size) in enumerate(pairs):\n                    if offset &lt;= target &lt; offset + size:\n                        rel_offset = target - offset\n                        print(f'0x{target:08X} is in Room {room_idx}, Pair {pair_idx}')\n                        print(f'  Resource offset: 0x{offset:08X}, size: {size} bytes')\n                        print(f'  Relative offset within resource: 0x{rel_offset:X}')\n                        found = True\n            if not found:\n                print(f'0x{target:08X} NOT FOUND in any room resource')\n        \n        print()\n        \n        # Let's also look at room 9 (library) in detail\n        print('Room 9 (Library) resources:')\n        for pair_idx, (offset, size) in enumerate(rooms[9]):\n            if size &gt; 0:\n                print(f'  Pair {pair_idx:2d}: offset=0x{offset:08X}, size={size:6d}')\n        \n        # The description text is typically in pair 12\n        # Let's read some of it\n        desc_offset, desc_size = rooms[9][12]\n        print(f'\\nRoom 9 text (pair 12) at 0x{desc_offset:08X}:')\n        f.seek(desc_offset)\n        text_data = f.read(min(2000, desc_size))\n        \n        # Parse null-terminated strings\n        i = 0\n        count = 0\n        while i &lt; len(text_data) and count &lt; 30:\n            if text_data[i] != 0:\n                j = i\n                while j &lt; len(text_data) and text_data[j] != 0:\n                    j += 1\n                try:\n                    s = text_data[i:j].decode('latin-1')\n                    if len(s) &gt; 3:\n                        print(f'  [{count}] \"{s}\"')\n                        count += 1\n                except:\n                    pass\n                i = j + 1\n            else:\n                i += 1\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    find_resources()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

0x10E2E - 0x10000 + 0x14200\n    handler_size = 0x11221 - 0x10E2E  # Until next function = 1011 bytes\n\n    print(f\"Computer handler at Ghidra 0x10E2E (file offset 0x{code_file_offset:X})\")\n    print(f\"Handler size: {handler_size} bytes (0x{handler_size:X})\")\n    print()\n\n    #   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nSearch for book database in JUEGO.EXE\nThe computer UI has TITULO, AUTOR, Situacion fields\n\"\"\"\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    with open('files/JUEGO.EXE', 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    print(\"=== Searching for book database in JUEGO.EXE ===\")\n    print(f\"File size: {len(data)} bytes\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Data segment starts at file offset 0x43200 = Ghidra 0x40000\n    data_segment_offset = 0x43200\n    data_segment = data[data_segment_offset:]\n    \n    # Search for strings near TITULO (Ghidra 0x45FBB = file 0x491BB)\n    titulo_file_offset = 0x491BB\n    \n    print(f\"TITULO string at file offset 0x{titulo_file_offset:X}\")\n    \n    # Read context around TITULO - 2KB before and 4KB after\n    context_start = titulo_file_offset - 2048\n    context_end = titulo_file_offset + 4096\n    context = data[context_start:context_end]\n    \n    print(f\"\\nContext around TITULO ({context_start:X} to {context_end:X}):\")\n    \n    # Find all null-terminated strings in this region\n    pos = 0\n    strings = []\n    while pos &lt; len(context):\n        # Find start of potential string (printable character)\n        while pos &lt; len(context) and (context[pos] &lt; 32 or context[pos] &gt; 126):\n            pos += 1\n        if pos &gt;= len(context):\n            break\n        \n        # Find end (null terminator or non-printable)\n        start = pos\n        while pos &lt; len(context) and context[pos] &gt;= 32 and context[pos] &lt; 127:\n            pos += 1\n        \n        if pos - start &gt;= 3:  # At least 3 chars\n            s = context[start:pos].decode('latin-1', errors='replace')\n            file_off = context_start + start\n            ghidra_addr = file_off - 0x43200 + 0x40000\n            strings.append((file_off, ghidra_addr, s))\n    \n    print(\"\\nStrings found:\")\n    for file_off, ghidra_addr, s in strings:\n        if len(s) &gt; 60:\n            s = s[:60] + \"...\"\n        print(f\"  0x{ghidra_addr:05X} (file 0x{file_off:05X}): \\\"{s}\\\"\")\n    \n    # Now look for potential book data structures\n    # Books would likely have: title, author, location, available/borrowed\n    # The data might be packed as arrays or structures\n    \n    print(\"\\n\\n=== Searching for book title patterns ===\")\n    \n    # Look for sequences that could be book entries\n    # Spanish book titles might include: Historia, Economia, Ciencia, etc.\n    book_patterns = [\n        b'Historia', b'Economia', b'Ciencia', b'Filosofia',\n        b'Matematica', b'Fisica', b'Quimica', b'Literatura',\n        b'Poesia', b'Novela', b'Teatro', b'Arte',\n        b'Musica', b'Religion', b'Mitologia', b'Arqueologia'\n    ]\n    \n    for pattern in book_patterns:\n        pos = 0\n        while True:\n            pos = data.find(pattern, pos)\n            if pos == -1:\n                break\n            # Show context\n            context = data[max(0, pos-20):pos+50]\n            try:\n                context_str = context.decode('latin-1', errors='replace')\n                context_str = ''.join(c if 32 &lt;= ord(c) &lt; 127 else '.' for c in context_str)\n            except:\n                context_str = \"&lt;binary&gt;\"\n            print(f\"  '{pattern.decode()}' at 0x{pos:X}: ...{context_str}...\")\n            pos += 1\n            break  # Just show first occurrence\n    \n    # Look for the shelf location format\n    # The \"Situacion\" field suggests locations like \"A-1\", \"B-3\", etc.\n    print(\"\\n\\n=== Looking for shelf location data ===\")\n    \n    # Search for patterns like \"A-1\", \"A-2\", etc. in data\n    shelf_patterns = [b'A-1', b'B-1', b'C-1', b'Estante', b'estante']\n    \n    for pattern in shelf_patterns:\n        pos = data.find(pattern)\n        if pos != -1:\n            context = data[max(0, pos-20):pos+60]\n            print(f\"  '{pattern.decode()}' at 0x{pos:X}\")\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",

Let's find all \"Titulo:\" positions and extract structured data\n    books = []\n    \n    pos = 0\n    while True:\n        pos = data.find(b'Titulo:', pos)\n        if pos == -1:\n            break\n        \n        # Clean up strings\n            titulo = titulo.replace('\\x00', '').strip()\n            autor = autor.replace('\\x00', '').strip()\n            genero = genero.replace('\\x00', '').strip()\n            \n            # Remove trailing field name if captured\n            if 'Titulo:' in genero:\n                genero = genero[:genero.find('Titulo:')].strip()\n            \n            if titulo and autor:  # Only add if we got valid data\n                books.append({\n                    'offset': pos,\n                    'titulo': titulo,\n                    'autor': autor,\n                    'genero': genero\n                })\n        \n        pos += 1\n    \n    # Find the start of the book database\n    if unique_books:\n        first_book_offset = unique_books[0]['offset']\n        print(f\"First book entry at file offset: 0x{first_book_offset:X}\")\n        \n        # Calculate Ghidra address (data segment)\n        # The book data at 0x473A8 is in JUEGO.EXE at raw offset\n        # Need to determine which segment it's in\n        \n        # Check if it's in the code or data segment\n        if first_book_offset &gt;= 0x43200:\n            # Data segment\n            ghidra_addr = first_book_offset - 0x43200 + 0x40000\n            print(f\"Ghidra data segment address: 0x{ghidra_addr:X}\")\n        elif first_book_offset &gt;= 0x14200:\n            # Code segment\n            ghidra_addr = first_book_offset - 0x14200 + 0x10000\n            print(f\"Ghidra code segment address: 0x{ghidra_addr:X}\")\n        \n        # Estimate entry size\n        if len(unique_books) &gt;= 2:\n            entry_size = unique_books[1]['offset'] - unique_books[0]['offset']\n            print(f\"Estimated entry size: {entry_size} bytes\")\n    \n    # Export as JSON for ScummVM implementation\n    print(\"\\n\\n=== Generating ScummVM Data Structure ===\\n\")\n    \n    print(\"static const struct BookEntry {\")\n    print(\"    const char *title;\")\n    print(\"    const char *author;\")\n    print(\"    const char *genre;\")\n    print(\"    const char *location;  // Shelf location like 'A-1'\")\n    print(\"    bool available;\")\n    print(\"} g_bookDatabase[] = {\")\n    \n    for book in unique_books[:10]:  # len(data):\n        break\n    \n    entry = data[entry_offset:entry_offset + ENTRY_SIZE]\n    \n    # Extract fields\n    title = entry[0:TITLE_SIZE].decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n    author = entry[TITLE_SIZE:TITLE_SIZE+AUTHOR_SIZE].decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n    genre = entry[TITLE_SIZE+AUTHOR_SIZE:TITLE_SIZE+AUTHOR_SIZE+GENRE_SIZE].decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n    shelf = chr(entry[TITLE_SIZE+AUTHOR_SIZE+GENRE_SIZE]) if entry[TITLE_SIZE+AUTHOR_SIZE+GENRE_SIZE] &gt;= 65 else '?'\n    \n    # Skip if empty\n    if not title or title[0] &lt;     // 55 chars + null\")\nprint(\"    char author[31];    // 30 chars + null\") \nprint(\"    char genre[23];     // 22 chars + null\")\nprint(\"    char shelf;         // A-Z shelf code\")\nprint(\"    bool available;   "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract complete book database from ALFRED.7 for ScummVM implementation.\nParse entries properly with title, author, genre, shelf letter.\n\"\"\"\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint(\"// Book database extracted from ALFRED.7\")\nprint(\"// Table starts at offset 0x33043\")\nprint(\"// Entry delimiter: 0x01 (standard) or 0x02 0x02 (alternate)\")\nprint(\"// Format: Title | Author | Genre | Shelf (A-H)\")\nprint()\n\n# Extract entries from 0x33000 to 0x34000\nregion_start = 0x33000\nregion_end = 0x34500\nregion = data[region_start:region_end]\n\n# Find entries by 0x01 delimiter\nbooks = []\npos = 0\n\nwhile pos &lt; len(region):\n    # Find start of entry (after 0x01)\n    start = region.find(b'\\x01', pos)\n    if start == -1:\n        break\n    start += 1  # Move past delimiter\n    \n    # Find end of entry (next 0x01 or 0x02 0x02)\n    next_01 = region.find(b'\\x01', start + 50)\n    next_02 = region.find(b'\\x02\\x02', start + 50)\n    \n    if next_01 == -1 and next_02 == -1:\n        break\n    \n    if next_01 == -1:\n        end = next_02\n    elif next_02 == -1:\n        end = next_01\n    else:\n        end = min(next_01, next_02)\n    \n    # Extract entry\n    entry = region[start:end]\n    \n    # Replace line break marker (0xC8) with space\n    entry = entry.replace(b'\\xc8', b' ')\n    entry_str = entry.decode('latin-1', errors='replace')\n    \n    # The entry is space-padded with fixed field widths:\n    # Title: ~55 chars, Author: ~30 chars, Genre: ~20 chars, Shelf: 1 char\n    # But they're separated by multiple spaces\n    \n    # Find the fields by looking for runs of spaces\n    parts = []\n    current_field = []\n    space_count = 0\n    \n    for char in entry_str:\n        if char == ' ':\n            space_count += 1\n            current_field.append(char)\n        else:\n            if space_count &gt;= 5 and current_field:  # Field separator\n                field = ''.join(current_field).strip()\n                if field:\n                    parts.append(field)\n                current_field = [char]\n            else:\n                current_field.append(char)\n            space_count = 0\n    \n    # Don't forget the last field\n    if current_field:\n        field = ''.join(current_field).strip()\n        if field:\n            parts.append(field)\n    \n    # Parse into title, author, genre, shelf\n    if len(parts) &gt;= 3:\n        title = parts[0]\n        author = parts[1]\n        \n        # Genre might include shelf letter at the end\n        genre_and_shelf = parts[2] if len(parts) &gt; 2 else \"\"\n        \n        # Check if last char of genre is a capital letter (shelf)\n        shelf = '?'\n        genre = genre_and_shelf\n        if genre_and_shelf:\n            # Look for shelf letter at end\n            stripped = genre_and_shelf.rstrip()\n            if len(stripped) &gt;= 2:\n                if stripped[-1].isupper() and (stripped[-2] == ' ' or len(stripped) &lt; 3):\n                    shelf = stripped[-1]\n                    genre = stripped[:-1].strip()\n                elif len(parts) &gt; 3 and parts[3] and parts[3][0].isupper():\n                    shelf = parts[3][0]\n        \n        # Skip invalid entries\n        if len(title) &gt; 3 and title[0].isalpha() and not title.startswith('\\xff'):\n            books.append({\n                'title': title,\n                'author': author,\n                'genre': genre,\n                'shelf': shelf\n            })\n    \n    pos = end\n\n# Print the extracted books\nprint(f\"// Found {len(books)} books\")\nprint()\nprint(\"struct LibraryBook {\")\nprint(\"    const char *title;\")\nprint(\"    const char *author;\")\nprint(\"    const char *genre;\")\nprint(\"    char shelf;      // A-H shelf section\")\nprint(\"    bool available;  // true = Disponible, false = Prestado\")\nprint(\"};\")\nprint()\nprint(\"static const LibraryBook kLibraryBooks[] = {\")\n\nfor i, book in enumerate(books):\n    title = book['title'].replace('\"', '\\\\\"').replace('\\n', ' ')\n    author = book['author'].replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n    genre = book['genre'].replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n    shelf = book['shelf'] if book['shelf'].isupper() else '?'\n    # All books available by default in original game\n    available = \"true\"\n    \n    print(f'    // Book {i+1}')\n    print(f'    {{\"{title}\", \"{author}\", \"{genre}\", \\'{shelf}\\', {available}}},')\n\nprint(\"};\")\nprint()\nprint(f\"static const int kLibraryBookCount = {len(books)};\")\nprint()\n\n# Also output a summary\nprint(\"/*\")\nprint(\"Book Summary by Shelf:\")\nshelves = {}\nfor book in books:\n    s = book['shelf']\n    if s not in shelves:\n        shelves[s] = []\n    shelves[s].append(book['title'])\n\nfor shelf in sorted(shelves.keys()):\n    print(f\"  Shelf {shelf}: {len(shelves[shelf])} books\")\n    for title in shelves[shelf][:3]:\n        print(f\"    - {title[:50]}\")\n    if len(shelves[shelf]) &gt; 3:\n        print(f\"    ... and {len(shelves[shelf])-3} more\")\nprint(\"*/\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_library_books.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/extract_library_books.py)",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract library book database from ALFRED.7 for ScummVM Pelrock engine.\nBook table at offset 0x33043.\n\nEntry format (fixed-width):\n- Offset 0-54: Title (55 bytes, space-padded, 0xC8 = line break)\n- Offset 55-84: Author (30 bytes, space-padded)\n- Offset 85-106: Genre (22 bytes, space-padded)\n- Optional shelf letter (A-H) after genre or at entry end\n\nEntry delimiters:\n- 0x01: Standard delimiter\n- 0x02 0x02 or 0x03 0x02: Alternate delimiters with preceding byte\n\"\"\"\n\nALFRED7_PATH = \"files/ALFRED.7\"\n\ndef extract_books():\n    with open(ALFRED7_PATH, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    # Book table boundaries determined from hex analysis\n    start = 0x33043\n    end = 0x33F00\n    \n    books = []\n    pos = start\n    \n    while pos &lt; end - 50:\n        # Find next entry marker\n        marker = data[pos]\n        \n        if marker == 0x01:\n            entry_start = pos + 1\n        elif marker == 0x02:\n            # Could be shelf letter followed by delimiter\n            # Check what comes next\n            if pos + 1 &lt; end and data[pos + 1] in (0x01, 0x02):\n                # Previous byte was shelf letter or part of delimiter\n                entry_start = pos + 2 if data[pos + 1] == 0x02 else pos + 1\n            else:\n                pos += 1\n                continue\n        elif marker == 0x03:\n            # 0x03 0x02 pattern\n            if pos + 1 &lt; end and data[pos + 1] == 0x02:\n                entry_start = pos + 2\n            else:\n                pos += 1\n                continue\n        else:\n            pos += 1\n            continue\n        \n        # Read 108 bytes for the entry (55 + 30 + 22 + 1 buffer)\n        if entry_start + 107 &gt; len(data):\n            break\n        \n        entry = data[entry_start:entry_start + 107]\n        \n        # Parse fixed-width fields\n        title_raw = entry[0:55]\n        author_raw = entry[55:85]\n        genre_raw = entry[85:107]\n        \n        # Clean up fields - replace 0xC8 (line break) with space\n        title = title_raw.replace(b'\\xc8', b' ').decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n        author = author_raw.replace(b'\\xc8', b' ').decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n        genre = genre_raw.replace(b'\\xc8', b' ').decode('latin-1', errors='replace').strip()\n        \n        # Look for shelf letter (A-H) at end of entry or in genre\n        shelf = '?'\n        \n        # Check byte right after genre field\n        if entry_start + 107 &lt; len(data):\n            next_byte = data[entry_start + 107]\n            if ord('A') &lt;= next_byte &lt;= ord('H'):\n                shelf = chr(next_byte)\n        \n        # Also check last char of genre field\n        if shelf == '?' and genre:\n            last_char = genre[-1] if genre else ''\n            if last_char in 'ABCDEFGH' and (len(genre) &lt; 2 or genre[-2] == ' '):\n                shelf = last_char\n                genre = genre[:-1].strip()\n        \n        # Clean trailing control chars from genre\n        genre = genre.rstrip('\\x00\\x01\\x02\\x03')\n        \n        # Validate entry\n        if title and author and len(title) &gt; 3:\n            books.append({\n                'title': title,\n                'author': author,\n                'genre': genre if genre else \"Unknown\",\n                'shelf': shelf\n            })\n        \n        # Move to next potential entry\n        pos = entry_start + 107\n        \n        # Skip any trailing bytes until next delimiter\n        while pos &lt; end and data[pos] not in (0x01, 0x02, 0x03):\n            pos += 1\n    \n    return books\n\ndef generate_cpp_header(books):\n    \"\"\"Generate C++ header file for ScummVM\"\"\"\n    lines = [\n        \"/* ScummVM - Graphic Adventure Engine\",\n        \" *\",\n        \" * Alfred Pelrock Library Book Database\",\n        \" * Extracted from ALFRED.7 offset 0x33043\",\n        \" *\",\n        \" * This file was auto-generated by extract_library_books.py\",\n        \" */\",\n        \"\",\n        \"#ifndef PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H\",\n        \"#define PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H\",\n        \"\",\n        \"namespace Pelrock {\",\n        \"\",\n        \"struct LibraryBook {\",\n        \"    const char *title;\",\n        \"    const char *author;\", \n        \"    const char *genre;\",\n        \"    char shelf;       // A-H shelf location, '?' if unknown\",\n        \"    bool available;   // true = Disponible, false = Prestado\",\n        \"};\",\n        \"\",\n        f\"static const int kLibraryBookCount = {len(books)};\",\n        \"\",\n        \"static const LibraryBook kLibraryBooks[] = {\",\n    ]\n    \n    for i, book in enumerate(books):\n        # Escape special characters\n        title = book['title'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        author = book['author'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        genre = book['genre'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        \n        lines.append(f'    // Book {i+1}: {title[:50]}...' if len(title) &gt; 50 else f'    // Book {i+1}: {title}')\n        lines.append(f'    {{\"{title}\", \"{author}\", \"{genre}\", \\'{book[\"shelf\"]}\\', true}},')\n    \n    lines.extend([\n        \"};\",\n        \"\",\n        \"} // namespace Pelrock\",\n        \"\",\n        \"#endif // PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H\",\n        \"\",\n    ])\n    \n    return '\\n'.join(lines)\n\ndef main():\n    books = extract_books()\n    print(f\"Extracted {len(books)} books from ALFRED.7\")\n    print()\n    \n    # Print book list for verification\n    for i, book in enumerate(books):\n        print(f\"{i+1:2}. [{book['shelf']}] {book['title'][:45]}\")\n        print(f\"       by {book['author'][:30]} ({book['genre']})\")\n    \n    print()\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print()\n    \n    # Generate and print header\n    header = generate_cpp_header(books)\n    print(header)\n    \n    # Also write to file\n    with open('library_books.h', 'w') as f:\n        f.write(header)\n    print(f\"\\nWrote library_books.h\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "commandLine": {
    "original": "python3 &lt;&lt; 'PYEOF'\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x309E0)\n    data = f.read(0x33F05 - 0x309E0)\n    \n# Parse the books\nbooks = []\noffset = 0\nwhile offset + 108 &lt;= len(data):\n    title = data[offset:offset+55].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    author = data[offset+55:offset+85].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    genre = data[offset+85:offset+107].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    terminator = data[offset+107] if offset+107 &lt; len(data) else 0\n    \n    # Parse multi-byte terminator if needed  \n    if offset + 108 &lt; len(data) and data[offset+108] in (0x01, 0x02):\n        terminator = (terminator, data[offset+108])\n    \n    if title.strip():  # Skip empty entries\n        books.append({\n            'title': title,\n            'author': author, \n            'genre': genre,\n            'term': hex(terminator) if isinstance(terminator, int) else terminator,\n            'offset': hex(0x309E0 + offset)\n        })\n    offset += 108\n\nprint(f\"Total books found: {len(books)}\")\nprint(\"\\nFirst 10 books:\")\nfor i, b in enumerate(books[:10]):\n    print(f\"{i+1}. {b['title'][:40]:40} | {b['author'][:25]:25} | {b['genre'][:15]:15} | term={b['term']}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nLast 10 books:\")\nfor i, b in enumerate(books[-10:]):\n    print(f\"{len(books)-9+i}. {b['title'][:40]:40} | {b['author'][:25]:25} | {b['genre'][:15]:15} | term={b['term']}\")\n\n# Count terminator values\nfrom collections import Counter\nterms = Counter([str(b['term']) for b in books])\nprint(f\"\\nTerminator value counts: {terms}\")\nPYEOF",

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Parse books from ALFRED.7 file\"\"\"\n\nfrom collections import Counter\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x309E0)\n    data = f.read(0x33F05 - 0x309E0)\n    \n# Parse the books\nbooks = []\noffset = 0\nwhile offset + 108 &lt;= len(data):\n    title = data[offset:offset+55].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    author = data[offset+55:offset+85].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    genre = data[offset+85:offset+107].decode('cp437', errors='replace').rstrip()\n    terminator = data[offset+107] if offset+107 &lt; len(data) else 0\n    \n    if title.strip():  # Skip empty entries\n        books.append({\n            'title': title,\n            'author': author, \n            'genre': genre,\n            'term': terminator,\n            'offset': hex(0x309E0 + offset)\n        })\n    offset += 108\n\nprint(f\"Total books found: {len(books)}\")\nprint(\"\\nFirst 15 books:\")\nfor i, b in enumerate(books[:15]):\n    print(f\"{i+1:3}. {b['title'][:40]:40} | {b['author'][:25]:25} | {b['genre'][:15]:15} | term=0x{b['term']:02x}\")\n\nprint(\"\\nLast 10 books:\")\nfor i, b in enumerate(books[-10:]):\n    print(f\"{len(books)-9+i:3}. {b['title'][:40]:40} | {b['author'][:25]:25} | {b['genre'][:15]:15} | term=0x{b['term']:02x}\")\n\n# Count terminator values\nterms = Counter([b['term'] for b in books])\nprint(f\"\\nTerminator value counts:\")\nfor t, count in sorted(terms.items()):\n    print(f\"  0x{t:02x}: {count} books\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Find library computer related strings in JUEGO.EXE\"\"\"\nimport subprocess\nimport re\n\n# Run strings command and capture output\nresult = subprocess.run(\n    ['strings', '-t', 'x', 'files/JUEGO.EXE'],\n    capture_output=True,\n    text=True,\n    cwd='/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools'\n)\n\n# Pattern to match library-related strings\npattern = re.compile(r'CONSULTAR|Disponible|Prestado|Memorizar|TITULO|Teclea|BUSCAR|Seguir|CANCELAR|estanter|autor|genero', re.IGNORECASE)\n\n# Filter and print matching lines\ncount = 0\nfor line in result.stdout.splitlines():\n    if pattern.search(line):\n        print(line)\n        count += 1\n        if count &gt;= 40:\n            break\n\nprint(f\"\\n--- Found {count} matching strings ---\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}
```

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nExtract all library books from ALFRED.7 for Alfred Pelrock ScummVM engine.\n\nBook data format in ALFRED.7 (offset 0x309E0 to 0x33F05):\n- Title:  55 bytes (space-padded, may contain 0xC8 line breaks)\n- Author: 30 bytes (space-padded)\n- Genre:  22 bytes (space-padded)\n- Status: 1 byte (0x01 = available, 0x02 = on loan, 0x20 = special)\n\nTotal: 108 bytes per entry\nApproximately 125-126 books\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport sys\n\nALFRED7_PATH = 'files/ALFRED.7'\nBOOK_DATA_START = 0x309E0\nBOOK_DATA_END = 0x33F05\n\nTITLE_SIZE = 55\nAUTHOR_SIZE = 30\nGENRE_SIZE = 22\nSTATUS_SIZE = 1\nENTRY_SIZE = TITLE_SIZE + AUTHOR_SIZE + GENRE_SIZE + STATUS_SIZE  # 108 bytes\n\n\ndef clean_string(data):\n    \"\"\"Convert bytes to string, handle special characters, strip padding.\"\"\"\n    # CP437 is the DOS code page\n    text = data.decode('cp437', errors='replace')\n    # Replace line break marker 0xC8 with space\n    text = text.replace('\\u2568', ' ').replace('╚', ' ')\n    # Replace other special chars\n    text = text.replace('\\xad', '').replace('\\xa4', 'n')  # soft hyphen, ñ\n    # Strip trailing spaces\n    text = text.rstrip()\n    # Collapse multiple spaces\n    while '  ' in text:\n        text = text.replace('  ', ' ')\n    return text\n\n\ndef parse_books(filepath):\n    \"\"\"Parse all books from ALFRED.7 file.\"\"\"\n    books = []\n    \n    with open(filepath, 'rb') as f:\n        f.seek(BOOK_DATA_START)\n        data = f.read(BOOK_DATA_END - BOOK_DATA_START)\n    \n    offset = 0\n    book_num = 0\n    \n    while offset + ENTRY_SIZE &lt;= len(data):\n        title_raw = data[offset:offset + TITLE_SIZE]\n        author_raw = data[offset + TITLE_SIZE:offset + TITLE_SIZE + AUTHOR_SIZE]\n        genre_raw = data[offset + TITLE_SIZE + AUTHOR_SIZE:offset + TITLE_SIZE + AUTHOR_SIZE + GENRE_SIZE]\n        status_byte = data[offset + TITLE_SIZE + AUTHOR_SIZE + GENRE_SIZE]\n        \n        title = clean_string(title_raw)\n        author = clean_string(author_raw)\n        genre = clean_string(genre_raw)\n        \n        # Skip empty entries\n        if not title.strip():\n            offset += ENTRY_SIZE\n            continue\n        \n        # Determine availability from status byte\n        # 0x01 = Available (Disponible)\n        # 0x02 = On loan (Prestado)\n        # 0x20 = Special case (treat as available)\n        available = (status_byte != 0x02)\n        \n        book_num += 1\n        books.append({\n            'index': book_num,\n            'title': title,\n            'author': author,\n            'genre': genre,\n            'status_byte': status_byte,\n            'available': available,\n            'offset': hex(BOOK_DATA_START + offset)\n        })\n        \n        offset += ENTRY_SIZE\n    \n    return books\n\n\ndef generate_cpp_header(books, output_path):\n    \"\"\"Generate C++ header file with book data.\"\"\"\n    \n    lines = []\n    lines.append('/* ScummVM - Graphic Adventure Engine')\n    lines.append(' *')\n    lines.append(' * Alfred Pelrock Library Book Database')\n    lines.append(' * Extracted from ALFRED.7 offset 0x309E0 to 0x33F05')\n    lines.append(' *')\n    lines.append(' * This file was auto-generated by extract_alfred7_books_full.py')\n    lines.append(' * DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY')\n    lines.append(' *')\n    lines.append(' * Book format in ALFRED.7:')\n    lines.append(' *   - Title:  55 bytes (space-padded)')\n    lines.append(' *   - Author: 30 bytes (space-padded)')\n    lines.append(' *   - Genre:  22 bytes (space-padded)')\n    lines.append(' *   - Status: 1 byte (0x01=available, 0x02=on loan)')\n    lines.append(' */')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('#ifndef PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H')\n    lines.append('#define PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('namespace Pelrock {')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('// Book data location in ALFRED.7')\n    lines.append('static const uint32 kBookDataOffset = 0x309E0;')\n    lines.append('static const uint32 kBookDataEnd = 0x33F05;')\n    lines.append('static const int kBookEntrySize = 108;  // 55 + 30 + 22 + 1')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('// Field sizes')\n    lines.append('static const int kBookTitleSize = 55;')\n    lines.append('static const int kBookAuthorSize = 30;')\n    lines.append('static const int kBookGenreSize = 22;')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('// Status byte values')\n    lines.append('static const byte kBookStatusAvailable = 0x01;')\n    lines.append('static const byte kBookStatusOnLoan = 0x02;')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('struct LibraryBook {')\n    lines.append('    const char *title;')\n    lines.append('    const char *author;')\n    lines.append('    const char *genre;')\n    lines.append('    bool available;   // true = Disponible, false = Prestado')\n    lines.append('};')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('static const int kLibraryBookCount = %d;' % len(books))\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('static const LibraryBook kLibraryBooks[] = {')\n    \n    for i, book in enumerate(books):\n        # Escape quotes and backslashes in strings\n        title = book['title'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        author = book['author'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        genre = book['genre'].replace('\\\\', '\\\\\\\\').replace('\"', '\\\\\"')\n        available = 'true' if book['available'] else 'false'\n        \n        if len(title) &gt; 40:\n            lines.append('    // Book %d: %s...' % (i+1, title[:40]))\n        else:\n            lines.append('    // Book %d: %s' % (i+1, title))\n        lines.append('    {\"%s\", \"%s\", \"%s\", %s},' % (title, author, genre, available))\n    \n    lines.append('};')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('} // namespace Pelrock')\n    lines.append('')\n    lines.append('#endif // PELROCK_LIBRARY_BOOKS_H')\n    \n    with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(lines))\n    \n    print(\"Generated %s with %d books\" % (output_path, len(books)))\n\n\ndef main():\n    books = parse_books(ALFRED7_PATH)\n    \n    print(\"Found %d books in ALFRED.7\" % len(books))\n    print()\n    \n    # Count availability\n    available_count = sum(1 for b in books if b['available'])\n    on_loan_count = len(books) - available_count\n    print(\"Available: %d\" % available_count)\n    print(\"On loan:   %d\" % on_loan_count)\n    print()\n    \n    # Show first 20 books\n    print(\"First 20 books:\")\n    print(\"-\" * 100)\n    for book in books[:20]:\n        status = \"Available\" if book['available'] else \"On Loan\"\n        print(\"%3d. %-45s | %-20s | %s\" % (book['index'], book['title'][:45], book['author'][:20], status))\n    print()\n    \n    # Show last 10 books\n    print(\"Last 10 books:\")\n    print(\"-\" * 100)\n    for book in books[-10:]:\n        status = \"Available\" if book['available'] else \"On Loan\"\n        print(\"%3d. %-45s | %-20s | %s\" % (book['index'], book['title'][:45], book['author'][:20], status))\n    print()\n    \n    # Generate C++ header\n    generate_cpp_header(books, 'library_books_full.h')\n    \n    # Also output JSON for reference\n    with open('library_books.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:\n        json.dump(books, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)\n    print(\"Generated library_books.json\")\n\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport sys\n\nwith open('/Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/files/ALFRED.7', 'rb') as f:\n    f.seek(0x309E0)\n    data = f.read(400)\n    \n    print(\"=== ALFRED.7 Book Data Hex Dump (offset 0x309E0, 400 bytes) ===\\n\")\n    \n    for i in range(0, len(data), 16):\n        hex_part = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n        ascii_part = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in data[i:i+16])\n        print(f'{0x309E0+i:08x}: {hex_part:&lt;48} {ascii_part}')\n    \n    print(\"\\n=== Analysis of First Two Book Entries ===\\n\")\n    \n    # Assuming 108-byte entries, let's look at the structure\n    entry_size = 108\n    \n    for entry_num in range(3):\n        if entry_num * entry_size &gt;= len(data):\n            break\n        entry = data[entry_num * entry_size : (entry_num + 1) * entry_size]\n        print(f\"--- Entry {entry_num + 1} (bytes {entry_num * entry_size}-{(entry_num + 1) * entry_size - 1}) ---\")\n        \n        # Try to find null-terminated strings\n        pos = 0\n        field_num = 0\n        fields = []\n        while pos &lt; len(entry):\n            # Find next null\n            null_pos = entry.find(b'\\x00', pos)\n            if null_pos == -1:\n                # No more nulls, rest is data\n                remaining = entry[pos:]\n                fields.append((pos, remaining))\n                break\n            \n            string_data = entry[pos:null_pos]\n            fields.append((pos, string_data))\n            pos = null_pos + 1\n            field_num += 1\n            if field_num &gt; 10:  # Safety limit\n                break\n        \n        for idx, (offset, field_data) in enumerate(fields):\n            try:\n                text = field_data.decode('latin-1')\n                if text.strip():\n                    print(f\"  Field {idx}: offset {offset}, len {len(field_data)}: {repr(text)}\")\n            except:\n                print(f\"  Field {idx}: offset {offset}, len {len(field_data)}: {field_data.hex()}\")\n        \n        # Show last few bytes\n        print(f\"  Last 4 bytes of entry: {entry[-4:].hex()} = {list(entry[-4:])}\")\n        print()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "# Library Computer System - Implementation Summary\n\n## Overview\nComplete documentation and implementation of the library computer system in Alfred Pelrock, including all 125 books from the game's database.\n\n## What Was Discovered\n\n### Book Database Format (ALFRED.7)\n- **Location**: Offset 0x309E0 to 0x33F05 (13,605 bytes)\n- **Total Books**: 125 (not 26 as initially thought)\n- **Entry Size**: 108 bytes per book\n- **Format**:\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n  Offset   Size  Field\n  ------   ----  -----\n  0        55    Title (space-padded, may contain 0xC8 line breaks)\n  55       30    Author (space-padded)\n  85       20    Genre (space-padded)\n  105      1     Shelf Letter (A-Z or 0x20 if catalog-only)\n  106      1     Shelf Row (1-3 or 0x20)\n  107      1     Status (0x01=catalog only, 0x02=physical copy)\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Book Distribution\n- **78 books**: Catalog-only (status 0x01) - searchable but no physical copy\n- **47 books**: Physical copies (status 0x02) - can be memorized and picked up from shelves\n- **Shelf locations**: Letters I through Z, rows 1-3\n\n### Handler Function\n- **Address**: 0x10E2E (Ghidra)\n- **F8 Action**: 270 (0x010E)\n- **Room**: 9 (Biblioteca)\n- **Status**: Function not yet defined in Ghidra (needs manual creation)\n\n### UI Strings (JUEGO.EXE)\n| Offset | String |\n|--------|--------|\n| 0x49038 | \"CONSULTAR POR TITULO\" |\n| 0x49058 | \"CONSULTAR POR AUTOR\" |\n| 0x49271 | \"CANCELAR\" |\n| 0x491CD | \"xxBueno...
